draft.title: Comment to claim this issue
draft.intro: Maintainers usually wait for a comment before assigning an issue. Here's a draft:
draft.hint: Replace the line in [brackets] with your own sentence on how you'd fix it. Copy-paste comments can look like spam.
draft.no_claim: This project's contributing guide says they don't assign issues, or that you can open a pull request without asking. A comment is optional.

next.none: Next: comment on GitHub and ask for the issue.

next.commented_slow.other: No answer for {count} days. A short, polite reminder is fine.
next.assigned: Next: write the code and open a pull request. Put this in its description so it links to the issue:
next.assigned_slow.other: Assigned {count} days ago and no pull request yet. If you've given up, say so in a comment so someone else can take it.
next.pr_open: Your pull request is being reviewed. Answer the comments you get.
